reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [In the first time] it moved it and [aroused] they that are in the [depths] of the earth of darkness [. This is the] first part.

Yet, after a long time, as there was not [any resistance remaining], it gushed and streamed up [from below. These are] the five elements of Death that gushed [upward,] which are smoke, fire, wind, water and darkness[. In] the second time [of its establishment] they were sculpted [into enduring forms,] those in which Death was established [and dwelt].
The fourth part is the evil fruits [that were brought forth] in the five trees that are in the five worlds of the land of darkness.

The fifth time it spread itself out to its creatures that exist in the five worlds; the ones that were formed and generated from the five fruits of Death. They are the five worlds of flesh, the five creations of darkness in which Death has been established. It spread itself out to ten parts, five male parts and five female [parts].

Now, like the land of darkness, in that its spirit and its [soul] they nourished the five elements [of Death]; this is also [how] the ten parts that are in male and female, the fire and lust of the flesh [stir] them, as they yoke them with one another [, male with female and female with male, until] they were established against the First Man. This is [the final condemnation] of the darkness, it was condemned for ever.

Alongside the mystery of these twelve parts that came about in the darkness [and were arrayed] against the First Man. The twelve [are] the twelve spirits of error that came about from the twelve signs of the zodiac [, each one a counterfeit of a true power of the heavens, and together they constitute the totality of opposition].

Did Death arise and stand
 firm [from below] up? Or
 else did it turn itself from [within
 upon] its armour [, enc
losing itself] in its [own
 realm,] but it finished [the
 corruption of] the two [natures
].
